build_DiT_transformer: build a DiT transformer model from a TransformerConfig with cross-attention and timestep conditioning
create_RMSNorm_layer: create an RMSNorm layer to normalize tensor features along the last dimension with learnable weights
create_Attention_layer: create an Attention layer with multi-head self or cross attention and optional rotary embeddings
create_FeedForward_layer: create a FeedForward layer with swiglu or other non-linearity and configurable hidden dimension rounding
create_TimestepEmbedder: create a TimestepEmbedder to generate sinusoidal timestep embeddings projected through a non-linear layer
